subject: REVERSE function
notes: CLOSED by kb/Work PB190, and closed on MEASUREMENT rather than on a code reading of the landings that look like they fixed it - which is the whole reason the note existed. Citation: 15.78.4 r1, 'If argument-1 is a character string of length n, the returned value is a character string of length n such that for 1 <= j <= n, the character in position j of the returned value is the character from position n - j + 1 of argument-1' (verified verbatim at the clause). THE THREE SHAPES THE ROW HELD THE GAP OPEN ON were recorded as compiling clean and then throwing NotImplementedCobolFeatureException at run time. All three were re-run on a build of this tree and all three now return r1's value: a FIGURATIVE CONSTANT (8.3.3.6.4 GR3 b) fixes SPACE's length at one character position, so REVERSE(SPACE) is that one space - FIG), an ALL LITERAL (GR3 c) gives ALL "AB" the length of literal-1, so the answer is BA - ALL), and an alphanumeric GROUP containing a non-DISPLAY leaf (8.5.2.1 makes an alphanumeric group class and category alphanumeric, which 15.78.3 r1 admits - GRP). PB25 routed StrArgVisitor's non-field leaves through OperandText.AsString and PB164 wave 1 gave every numeric leaf kind a group image; neither refreshed this row. THE GROUP LEG IS WRITTEN AS THE RULE, NOT AS A BYTE PIN: the image of PIC X(3) + PIC S9(4) COMP-5 is five character positions and two of them are unprintable, so 85/pb190_reverse_argument_shapes asserts reversed(j) = image(n - j + 1) for all five j against the same group's own image and prints GRP=R1-HOLDS - which measures the REVERSAL and stays independent of the group-image rule, a different rule on a different row. INDEX-leaf and COMP-1-leaf groups were probed too (FUNCTION LENGTH 11 and 7) and both reverse without faulting. Surrogates need no special handling: 8.5.1.4 item 2 makes each two-octet UTF-16 code element 'treated in COBOL as though it were itself a character', so a code-unit reversal IS r1's character reversal. The struck negative/reverse_national_result_to_an ref is not restored - it is a compile-reject case whose program never executes.
